key_idea: A hypothetical dimension deficit forces hidden information into fair two-point conditional laws at fine scales, which then yield entropy gains that telescope over disjoint observation windows to produce an impossible unbounded entropy.
reason: The argument beautifully recasts a geometric problem into an information-theoretic one, using conditional entropies to uncover structure without needing separation or arithmetic assumptions. The core mechanism is highly explanatory and surprising, though executing the multiscale telescoping inevitably involves a moderate amount of technical bookkeeping.
